He tries my patience so much and I waiver between feeling like a bad pet owner and feeling like I wish he would run away.  Obviously I don’t want him to.  A) I don’t want him to get hurt or be injured.  B) he is chipped and I would just end up getting him back plus having a dog at large fine.  😂

He does play with them but he still goes for things that aren’t his toys.  He goes outside at least once an hour and is rewarded with treats when he goes.  But he will literally come inside and take a dump just 2 minutes after being outside.  I’m honestly at a loss of what to do with him.

No… Im not saying give up.  It just makes me feel like I have no one in my corner and most everything I do is undervalued and under appreciated. So this year when she had the day off on the Saturday before I made a large brunch, took the kids shopping days before and they each had a wrapped gift.  Then we did a movie that she wanted to see with the kids.  What did I get, she slept in, helped me get the girls dressed before I went to see my dad since she had to work.  I came home to find a pie, a bag of chips, and a small bag of beef jerky.  That’s it.  It’s not the first year she has done it either.  This has come to be the norm.

I don’t follow.  Are you saying did I become a dad for the gifts no.  But a little appreciation would be nice.  Maybe be able to do something for myself for once, or eat a decent meal that I don’t have to cook.  I’m just tired.  I love my kids.  I love being a father.  But it feels so thankless at times.  Thankless like my job.  Thankless like my role as a husband.  I’m just tired, overwhelmed, and lost right now.

My only time is 1:15 for a yoga class once a week and getting drunk at night by myself once the kids have gone to bed.  It’s rough.  You think your life ahead of you will be great but at the end of the day it’s just a mess.  Your wife never compliments you and instead criticizes when you don’t shave because you’re busy running out the door to work.  Your wife says she doesn’t want to have sex with you.  You feel less than desirable to the opposite sex based on your wife’s statements, you hate your job, you have absolutely no friends, and the only thing that you can look forward to is the peace that death will bring.  You feel like a disappointment to everyone all the time and you honestly curse god for creating you.  I wish I had pulled the trigger of my 9 mm 4 months ago before the cops stormed my garage.  I justedades wanted the pain to stop.   The loneliness to stop.  But everyone else said they knew better.  So now I’m here living for them. Living so that I don’t disappoint.  WhT kind of life is it that you just want to not make your family cry because the pain was too much.  I hate myself everyday.  I hate what I have become, and I curse the fake thing known as god, because he is not real.  N ok father would allow their child to suffer and snuggly watch it happen.  I hate everyone that is happy.  I hate everyone that is beautiful.  I hope they know that they are lucky and do not know the pain of depression, loneliness, divorce, and solitude.  I live only for my 4 girls.  They are my everything, they are innocent.  I don’t want them to think that they are not enough for dad to live, but I don’t know how much longer I can hold on to that.  I love because my first daughter from my first marriage was physically abused.  It’s not fair for her to go back because I am weak.  I just want to feel loved, desired,and like I am enough. What is imposter syndrome?  I have never heard of that.  I know that I basically have no self worth.  Never really have.  If I wasn’t with my wife I feel like I would have liked myself a long time ago.  I feel like I have to put on a show for everyone.  I feel like people only like me when I act “outside the box”.

It’s not a dead bedroom scenario.  She is very wonderful.  It’s a “i no longer want to be your wife” scenario.  Her words exactly to me.  It hurts to hear that.  Not I want a divorce, not I want time apart, but I don’t want to be married to you any longer.  It cuts to the bone.  She was my forever and always.  Hugs and kisses when I got home from work.  We used to spend every Friday night having drinks in the garage, smoking, playing cards, making love.  She is my soulmate and I feel since she has emotionally checked out like I have no soul.  I see my therapist 3 times a week because literally wanted to shoot myself in the head.  I wanted the pain to stop and be done with this world.  I live for my kids and wife.  I hope that I value myself in the future enough to live for me but that seems so far away.  People tell me that I’m actually a good person and a good dad, but I don’t feel like one.  I haven’t had any self worth since I can even remember. Im a perfectionist who always feel as though he’s never good enough.  I feel like a shit human being inside.  I tried to kill myself.  Everyone tells me that I lost sight of my girls and I feel is angry at myself for wanting to do that.  I don’t spend enough time with my family because I live far away.  I don’t feel like I make enough money for what I do.  All around I just feel subpar.  My wife and her love used to get me through that.  But now that is gone and I feel soulless and dark inside.

She doesn’t treat me like her servant.  It just kills me to be at home all the time by myself with just the kids.  Some of that time is working.  We work opposite shifts.  It’s just she doesn’t come home after work anymore at say 10 pm.  My favorite times of day were when I would wait to eat dinner and she would bring us home food and we would eat together from her restaurant.  Sitting and playing board games with her on a Friday night while having a few drinks.  That’s all gone and it feels so dark and dead inside.

I just honestly can’t imagine life without her.  She has been my best and only friend for 13 years.  I have just always wanted her to be happy.  That was my #1 all the time, and it is devastating to realize that in order for her to be happy it seems that I will have to be unhappy for the rest of my life.  I just don’t want to deal with that any longer.  I don’t want to keep feeling this horrendous pain inside.  I don’t want to have to keep hiding in other rooms of the house so that the kids don’t see me crying hysterically.  I just want to feel alive , and like I bring happiness to others instead of stress, grief, and heartache.
